reason: Test the schedule proposal first: it changes only the order of updates to the four independent ZA accumulators, preserving loads, reduction order, and stores. The fresh incumbent scores vary widely, and the paired-load candidate regressed in all three fresh pairs, so neither supports attributing a cause or predicting this schedule’s result. Next test streaming-region cost and the three equivalent vector-store proposals as one distinct store-path hypothesis; local assembly and the tutorial support investigating it, but only at probe or different-implementation scope. Test the full-tile store simplification and tile-order change next. The remaining proposals change packing, scratch layout, or transpose work and carry greater copy, cache-capacity, and correctness risk. Every proposal remains unmeasured on this hill; this order is a testing priority, not a prediction of gains.
